description:
Manage tasks: turn ACTION: lines in notes and logs into TASK: anchors, then read and change those anchors. The source files are the only store.

Subcommands:
  ingest [--dry-run] [--quiet] — rewrite every ACTION: line in all thread notes/ and logs/ into a TASK: anchor with a new 8-char uuid (bare `tasks` does the same)
  add THREAD TEXT [--due D] [--scheduled D] [--priority P] [--depends UUID] — append an ACTION to the buffer (same as `buffer add-action`)
  done UUID — mark complete: TASK -> DONE, stamp end:<today>
  set-description UUID TEXT — replace the body
  set-assignee UUID PERSON — replace the (Assignee) prefix
  set-due UUID DATE — set the due date
  set-scheduled UUID DATE — set the scheduled date
  set-priority UUID PRIORITY — set the priority (writes [#X])
  add-depends UUID DEP_UUID — add a dependency
  rm-depends UUID DEP_UUID — remove a dependency
  list [--priority P] [--thread T] [--assignee A] [--overdue] [--json] — pending tasks grouped by thread A-Z, then priority/due/entry
  next — top 5 pending tasks by (priority, due, entry)
  show UUID — detail view of one task

Args:
  UUID, DEP_UUID: task uuid from `tasks list`; any unique prefix works. For rm-depends, DEP_UUID is a prefix matching one of this task's dependencies.
  THREAD: 'Kind/Name', e.g. Projects/Northwind.
  TEXT (add): '(Assignee) description' or 'description'.
  PERSON: a name with a file at people/<Name>.md; a leading 'people/' is allowed.
  DATE: YYYY-MM-DD. PRIORITY: H, M or L.

Flags:
  ingest (also valid before any subcommand on bare `tasks`):
    --dry-run  show what would be ingested; write nothing
    --quiet    no per-action output
  add:
    --due YYYY-MM-DD, --scheduled YYYY-MM-DD, --priority H|M|L
    --depends UUID8  8-char uuid of a task; repeatable
  list:
    --priority H|M|L  only this priority
    --thread Kind/Name  only tasks whose source note carries this thread
    --assignee NAME  only tasks for this person
    --overdue  only tasks due before today
    --json  JSON output

Examples:
  ["list", "--thread", "Projects/Northwind", "--json"]
  ["add", "Projects/Northwind", "(Sam Rivera) Send quarterly report", "--due", "2026-11-15", "--priority", "H"]
  ["done", "abcd1234"]
  ["set-due", "abcd1234", "2026-12-01"]

Notes:
  Nothing prompts.
  ingest, done and every set-*/add-depends/rm-depends subcommand rewrite source note and log files in place. Never edit TASK:/DONE: lines by hand.
  `add` only queues an ACTION in buffer.md. It becomes a task, with a uuid, only after `buffer flush`, which runs ingest itself, so you do not need to run `tasks` afterwards.
  Exit 1: no task matches the uuid prefix, empty prefix, date not YYYY-MM-DD, person has no people/<Name>.md, empty description, or a task depends on itself.
